title: Wizard: detect a migration alias collision from the preview and offer the fix before applying
description:
Follow-up to LCLI-465 (which exposed --preserve-source-ids/--source-family as non-interactive flags). opum-agent's approved item 2: 'Surface the preview's collision rather than a bare exit 5... Prefer asking before applying, over reporting after failing: you have a preview step and an interactive wizard, so you can detect the collision and offer the flags before anything is attempted.'

Today the interactive wizard's migrate choice runs the same migrateBacklogTasksToQuest path LCLI-465 fixed for the flag path, but has no way to retry with --preserve-source-ids/--source-family since the wizard never asks about them -- a wizard user hitting the alias collision still gets a bare exit 5, even though the flag path can now avoid it entirely.

Confirmed via quest-cli: their message fix (QCLI-256) now distinguishes the two collision causes -- positional renumbering (LCLI-465's fix applies) vs. a genuine dual id claim (no automatic fix exists, needs manual resolution). Any wizard-side collision handling must read which cause a refusal names before assuming --preserve-source-ids helps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The wizard's migrate path runs Quest's preview first (as today) and, on an alias-collision refusal, distinguishes positional-renumbering causes (offer to retry with --preserve-source-ids/--source-family, prompting for the family) from a genuine dual-claim collision (explain that this needs manual resolution, per quest-cli's QCLI-256 message)
A wizard user who accepts the retry offer gets a successful migration without re-running lore init by hand
Verified against a real repro (both collision shapes) in a real terminal, not just unit tests
